name: infogen-workbuddy
description: New SpaceEngine Detailed Information Generator with AI
description_zh: 加入了AI的SpaceEngine详细信息生成器，适配0.99x，可向下兼容0.980。
description_en: New SpaceEngine Detailed Information Generator with AI

mcp_url.description: InfoGen MCP 服务地址（HTTP 模式）；服务以 -Dport=<端口> 更换端口时需同步修改

hooks.description: InfoGen MCP 连通性只读探测：连续失败 3 次后从窗口顶部静默提醒并结束本次查询，不崩端、不影响其他功能

displayDescription.en: Retrieves SpaceEngine system and celestial object data, then writes traceable, data-grounded extended lore covering minerals, civilizations, biospheres and habitability.
displayDescription.zh: 基于SpaceEngine行星系统数据检索系统与天体参数，生成矿产、文明、生态等可溯源的扩展设定文档

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 启用 InfoGen-WorkBuddy，帮我查询【系统名】的系统概览
defaultInitPrompt.en: Enable InfoGen-WorkBuddy and show the overview of system [system]
